summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Baytex Energy Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting Q1 2026 results, a production guidance increase, a 3-year growth outlook, and announcing the completion of a CEO transition. Chad Lundberg assumes the role of President and CEO, succeeding the prior executive, and joins the Board of Directors. The filing details operational and financial highlights but does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return (beyond routine buybacks), spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, or SPAC. The filing solely discloses a routine management succession as part of normal corporate governance, not a forced or abrupt departure. The company repurchased shares as part of ongoing capital return, but this is not a standalone special situation event. US-equivalent: voluntary current report under Form 6-K. What to watch: future operational updates and capital allocation decisions under new leadership; no immediate risk-arb angle.
